rule: A material architecture assumption without an observable invalidation signal is not allowed to become an implicit production invariant.

assumptions.statement: DBOS + PostgreSQL can provide adequate durability, queues, waits, messages, and recovery for the first Workspace Semantic Execution backend slice without requiring custom replay/event-sourcing infrastructure.
evidence: DBOS open-source runtime checkpoints workflows/steps into Postgres.
DBOS supports durable queues, messages, HITL, recovery, and agent integrations.
No separate orchestrator server is required for the initial single-application deployment.
assumptions.risk_if_false: We recreate missing workflow machinery or accumulate operational fragility.
assumptions.observable_signal: First real workflow requires custom recovery/queue/wait/versioning logic outside the runtime adapter.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Two or more important durable semantics require bespoke workarounds, or recovery behavior cannot be represented cleanly behind DurableRuntimePort.
assumptions.fallback: Spike Restate on the same workflow contract; evaluate Temporal if platform-scale workflow semantics are required.

assumptions.statement: A modular monolith is simpler and more reliable than an initial microservice decomposition for the expected workload.
evidence: Current workload is human/ChatGPT-scale rather than high-throughput service-scale.
SRE guidance favors simplicity and modularity before distributed decomposition.
No component currently requires independent scaling except external executors already behind adapters.
assumptions.risk_if_false: One component causes contention, deployment coupling, or failure propagation that requires independent lifecycle/scaling.
assumptions.observable_signal: Profiling or incidents show a module needs independent scaling/fault containment.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: A concrete module repeatedly violates resource/reliability targets because of process co-location.
assumptions.fallback: Extract only that bounded context behind the existing port; do not redesign all modules.

assumptions.statement: Git/GitHub should remain project/task/source authority but should not be the hot runtime coordination database.
evidence: Existing Git-CAS/controller work exposed latency and concurrency complexity.
Hot state requires transactional leases/generations/ready queues.
Meaningful checkpoints still benefit from immutable Git provenance.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Runtime DB diverges from required authority or loses important auditability.
assumptions.observable_signal: Real workflow cannot cleanly distinguish runtime facts from Git-authoritative project/task facts.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: A required authority decision depends on runtime state that cannot be safely reconciled with Git source contracts.
assumptions.fallback: Add explicit reconciliation/checkpoint protocol; do not revert to per-transition Git mutation.

assumptions.statement: The semantic ontology graph is most useful as a derived temporal/provenance/context projection rather than the transactional scheduler store.
evidence: Graph-shaped queries dominate meaning/provenance/contradiction/context needs.
Transactional claims/leases/idempotency are better served by relational/durable-runtime primitives.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Context compilation becomes awkward or semantic/runtime duplication drifts.
assumptions.observable_signal: Real workflows require frequent deep graph traversals or semantic updates that are difficult/slow in the initial relational projection.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Measured query complexity/latency or developer complexity materially improves with a dedicated graph substrate.
assumptions.fallback: Introduce graph database adapter while preserving authoritative ownership and projection rebuild rules.

assumptions.statement: GPT-6 Instant can serve as the default reasoning quantum when work is recursively bounded, context is curated, and external validation is available.
evidence: Current OpenAI product identity: GPT-6 Sol powers Instant on eligible paid ChatGPT plans.
Workspace Control GPT-6 Instant protocol screening has validated bounded tasks.
External reasoning/test-time compute literature supports decomposed, feedback-driven cycles.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Excessive repair/decomposition overhead or poor reasoning quality overwhelms benefits.
assumptions.observable_signal: Real-workflow telemetry shows repeated validator failures, premature convergence, or frequent High escalation for supposedly bounded leaves.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Validated progress per Instant quantum is consistently worse than a stronger-effort route for the same phenotype after decomposition.
assumptions.fallback: Adjust routing profile; preserve architecture and map affected phenotype to stronger executor.

assumptions.statement: Persistent ChatGPT sessions are useful working-memory caches but not required for correctness or recovery.
evidence: Durable state and packet reconstruction already work mechanically.
Long-horizon research warns that large uncurated histories cause context degradation.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Fresh durable resume loses important tacit context and materially harms performance.
assumptions.observable_signal: Matched real workflows show strong persistent-session advantage despite equivalent durable packets.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Persistent sessions produce materially higher validated success or lower reasoning cost for a recurring phenotype.
assumptions.fallback: Increase affinity/reuse for that phenotype while preserving durable recovery boundary.

assumptions.statement: The control plane can run with zero GPU allocation and modest CPU/RAM because model inference is remote and heavy project compute is delegated to executors.
evidence: DBOS runtime overhead is database/checkpoint oriented.
Human/Instant-worker orchestration rate is far below documented DBOS/Postgres throughput.
CUDA visibility can be explicitly disabled for control-plane processes.
assumptions.risk_if_false: Scheduler competes with research workloads or causes workstation instability.
assumptions.observable_signal: Resource telemetry violates control-plane fitness targets under representative workload.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: Steady control-plane CPU >= one core, app RSS > 1 GiB, any GPU VRAM allocation, or Postgres resource use is disproportionate to workload.
assumptions.fallback: Profile and simplify; isolate components; tune Postgres; only then reconsider budgets.

assumptions.statement: A small custom agent loop plus typed domain state is more debuggable and durable for this project than adopting a general-purpose agent framework in the core.
evidence: 2026 source-code study of eleven production coding harnesses found hand-written loops and no general agent framework in their core runtimes.
Anthropic recommends simple composable patterns and warns frameworks can obscure prompts/responses.
assumptions.risk_if_false: We spend unnecessary effort rebuilding useful framework primitives.
assumptions.observable_signal: Core loop accumulates generic plumbing unrelated to Workspace semantics.
assumptions.invalidation_trigger: A mature harness SDK/framework removes substantial code without obscuring state, prompts, tools, or recovery semantics.
assumptions.fallback: Adopt it behind domain ports after a concrete diff/prototype proves simplification.
